summary: The article accurately reports Hitachi Energy India's Q2 FY27 financial results and details of the PM Dhara GEC Phase III scheme, citing figures consistent with official company announcements and government reports.

claims.claim: Hitachi Energy India reported a standalone revenue from operations of ₹2,996.5 crore, marking a substantial 63.5% increase compared to ₹1,832.6 crore in the same period last year.
claims.note: Official company results and multiple news sources confirm these figures for Q2 FY27.

claims.claim: The net profit after tax (PAT) also saw a healthy rise, climbing 20.5% year-on-year to ₹318.5 crore, up from ₹264.4 crore in Q2 FY26.
claims.note: Official company results and multiple news sources confirm these figures for Q2 FY27.

claims.claim: New order inflows soared by an impressive 85.9% year-on-year, reaching ₹4,120.8 crore.
claims.note: Official company results and multiple news sources confirm this figure for Q2 FY27.

claims.claim: This significant influx of new business pushed the company's total order backlog to a record-high of ₹33,335.4 crore as of September 2026.
claims.note: Official company results and multiple news sources confirm this figure as of September 2026.

claims.claim: The operational EBITDA margin improved to 16.5% in Q2 FY27, up from 15.9% in the corresponding quarter last year.
claims.note: Official company results and news reports confirm the operational EBITDA margin for Q2 FY27.

claims.claim: The government's initiatives, including the PM Dhara GEC Phase III, with approved investments of ₹1.86 lakh crore to connect 135 GW of renewable capacity, provide a structural tailwind for the industry.
claims.note: Multiple government and news sources confirm the PM Dhara GEC Phase III scheme with an outlay of ₹1.86 lakh crore and a target of 135 GW renewable capacity.

claims.claim: Official financial reports, including quarterly results and annual reports, are typically available on the company's investor relations section of its website, as well as on the websites of stock exchanges like NSE and BSE, and SEBI's official portal.
claims.note: SEBI's website provides links to corporate filings, including financial results, on NSE and BSE.
